description:
I went on a fave spree favoriting deviations about low poly models with cool textures and wood, stone, and brick textures (you can look under 3D in the favorite section of my DA page if you want to see). Then I had the desire to practice texture painting because I was like "Why not? I want to learn how to make textures for games I could make."


But....there wasn't a solid wood and stone texture painting tutorial I could use with the look I had in mind so I ended up using reference photos I found on google...

this didn't turn out the way I way I wanted it XD!

Well at least it looks decent! But I don't understand how these people where able to make those cartoony medieval textures for environments, houses, wood, stone, and items! I'm trying to go for a Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild texture sorta feel....

If any has a technique I can use to help me texture paint let me know. I could really use it! :)

title: Vent Art - I suck
description:
I am a teen.
Who likes to play with slime.
Who'd rather play minecraft than go to a dance.
Who'd rather spend her days drawing .
Who'd stay away from what she thinks is wierd.
Who'd frail her hands around at random times.

I am a teen who is new to society.

I was a girl.
Who was scared of going outside.
Who was scared of men.
Who was kept away from the world.
Who used to play with her younger sister all the time.
Who worried a lot.
Who wished her parents were together.
Who knew things she shouldn't.
Who had to play "mom".

I was a girl who was forced to grow up.

Now I am a teen.
Who is new to "being free".
Who is experiencing new things quickly.
Who doesn't love her mom as much as she used to.
Who doesn't know how to be a teen.
Who is trying to admit to her feelings.
Who now has a crush.
Who hates being 16.
Who is trying to find a way in life.
Who doesn't know if her way is right.
Who wishes that people weren't so mean to each other.
Who wishes that she can express herself better.
Who feels that her personality sucks.
Who feels that maybe she should stay quiet.
Who feels awkward with everyone else.
Who doesn't know which path to take.
Who is trying to stay gold.

I am a teen who is wondering about her future.

I have been reading poems in my English class that have a lot of meaning. 

I have read Robert Frost's The Road not Taken and Nothing Gold can Stay.

I have also found 2 other poems that speaks to me.....



I have been feeling sad as you guys know and Im slowly getting better. But I wonder if I am doing anything wrong. I wonder if my decisions are worth it. Given the events that had happened to me so far since I turned 16 ( The drama, friends being sad, finding out that mom will never be there for you, and an argument I had with a friend a few days ago), I feel like maybe its me. That maybe there is something wrong with me. I try my best to be the best person I can be and try to put others first. But some friends say that Im fine and that I need to take care of myself. Its hard. I dont want to end up like my mom who selfish, complains alot, and wont listen to others feelings. But I am like her in some ways, shy take things too seriously, and can't let some things go.....

I never had friends before and they are one of the best thing I ever had. I want to be there for them as much as I can....

But now its like Im not motivated to do much. I have so much to do but I dont have enough will to do it. 

I want to get better. I am seeing a councilor and I have started to write in diaries like I used to when I was younger. I miss the old days.....I wish I could make things different. But this is life I guess.....

title: Petpetpark: Pinixy (Fanart)
description: I had a dream last night about an online world I used to play on when I was little called PetPetPark. I was in an arcade of some sort in a town and the games were related to PetPetPark and Neopets (The were made by the same company) After I woke up from the dream I was hit by a wave of nostalgia and sadness. The park closed and I didn't even know since my bio mom restricted me and my sister from using the desktop (for a very stupid reason) and when I was finally able to play on it again I was introduced with a note that said it was closed. I was super upset since the other online world I used to play on, Pixie Hollow, had closed down before that and that I missed PetPetPark's final moments. Throughout the years I would occasionally look on the internet to see if both of those worlds would come back. I kinda lost hope for the Pixie Hollow but not PetPetPark. It was so good and it was my first online world I ever joined before the others. I would get little updates that it might come back for real but nothing really has happened. UNTIL TODAY. When I looked on Google after I woke up from the this morning, I found out that in February of this year, some people found files previously cached and archived before PetPetPark closed. They are currently trying to rebuild the rooms from the game. I am so excited for this! The dream I had was a sign! I really hope they are successful. I would love to spend hours playing it again!
